# SearchWorks

> > Stanford University's library catalog providing access to millions of books, articles, digital collections, government documents, and special collections across all disciplines.

SearchWorks is the discovery platform for Stanford University Libraries, offering comprehensive access to physical and electronic resources including ProQuest digital collections, government documents from the U.S. Department of Energy and Oak Ridge National Laboratory, conference proceedings, and rare materials housed in SAL3 and other library locations.

## Key Topics

- Stanford University Libraries
- Library catalog and discovery
- Digital collections and electronic resources
- Government documents and technical reports
- Congressional hearings and U.S. legislative materials
- ProQuest digital collections
- Conference proceedings
- Department of Energy publications
- Oak Ridge National Laboratory reports
- Special collections and archives
- WorldCat integration
- SAL3 (Stanford Auxiliary Library)
- Academic research materials
- Interdisciplinary scholarship

## Government Documents and Technical Reports

- [Future space programs 1975 [electronic resource]](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/11036892): 1975 congressional hearings on space programs from U.S. House committee
- [INVESTIGATION OF VAPOR VOLUME FRACTION AND SLIP VELOCITY UNDER THE EURATOM PROGRAM](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/11806869): 1963 EURATOM report on two-phase flow vapor fraction by Allis-Chalmers
- [Water washes and caustic leaches of sludge from Hanford Tank S-101](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/11275820): Oak Ridge study on radioactive waste treatment at Hanford Reservation
- [TRENDS 1991 [electronic resource]: A compendium of data on global change](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/11270359): 1991 climate data compendium on CO2 emissions from Oak Ridge Lab

## Science and Technology Conference Proceedings

- [2016 International Conference on ICT For Smart Society (ICISS)](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/12489605): IEEE conference proceedings on ICT for smart cities, Surabaya 2016
- [Information and communications security: 16th International Conference, ICICS 2014](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/11511126): ICICS 2014 conference proceedings on cryptography and network security
- [Eco-efficient Construction and Building Materials [electronic resource]](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/10619909): Guide to sustainable building materials with LCA and eco-labelling methods

## Research and Academic Studies

- [Characterization of natural fractures in Mesaverde core [electronic resource]](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/11187695): Geological study of natural fractures in Mesaverde Formation, Colorado
- [Self-assembly of block copolymers on topographically patterned polymeric substrates](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/11711877): Materials science study on block copolymer self-assembly, UMass Amherst
- [Out there: landscape architecture on global terrain](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/12368274): Exhibition catalog on global landscape architecture and urban ecology

## History and Cultural Studies

- [Presenze ebraiche in Umbria meridionale dal Medioevo all'Età moderna](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/12117672): Conference proceedings on Jewish history in Umbria, medieval to modern
- [al-Mawsūʻah al-Filasṭīnīyah al-shāmilah](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/11972959): Comprehensive Palestinian encyclopedia on Arab-Israeli conflict by al-Zarw
- [Types et uniformes. L'armée française](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/1249869): 19th century illustrated book on French military uniforms by Detaille
- [Letter from John Pownall to Patrick Tonyn confirming that all future correspondence should be sent via the Admiral](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/12676839): 1775 colonial letter from Pownall to Tonyn on East Florida communications

## Literature and Poetry Collections

- [Poemas encontrados y otros pre-textos](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/12680660): Chilean poetry collection by Jorge Torres, found poems and pre-texts
- [Haus der Halluzinationen, oder, Unwelts Heimkehr](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/10728172): Contemporary German poetry collection by Steffen Popp, Hablizel publisher

## Optional

- [Samuel J. Broad: a collection of his writings](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/10044753): Collected writings of accountant Samuel J. Broad from Accounting Hall
- [Modal slope, Rukwa Region, Mpanda and Sumbawanga Districts, Tanzania](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/11886952): 1979 topographic map of Rukwa Region, Tanzania by land use bureau
- [Novelette [electronic resource]](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/10320137): Wind quintet recording by Tokyo Winds featuring Poulenc and Dvořák
- [The other 8 hours: you sleep 8. You work 8. Now maximize your free time](https://searchworks.stanford.edu/view/10251072): Time management and wealth creation guide by Robert Pagliarini
